[LGRA.2.3.1] Indentation is exactly 4 spaces per level. The lexer
emits `INDENT`, `DEDENT`, and `NEWLINE` synthetic tokens
that the productions below consume. Full rules at [LLEX.6].
Inside parentheses `(` / `)`, square brackets `[ ]`, or
curly braces `{ }`, indentation tracking is suspended and any
leading-space count is legal (LLEX.7.5.5). This is the
standard mechanism for multi-line expressions.
